card.name: Science news prose, key nouns
card.fires_on: Words in general science news stories (astronomy, physics, energy, neuroscience, genetics) that sit inside a topic phrase, such as 'measuring', 'secrets', 'hydrogen' or 'structure'. It also fires on the end of 'prostheses'.
